findings.finding: The stdlib bootstrap hashes outer and manifest files but does not recursively expand and live-verify the exact v5 resource controller/worker, v7 publisher/candidate code, recovery-v2 seven members, candidate-v4 bundle, and provenance transitive paths before controller or science import.
The production worker does not repeat the complete frozen dependency-closure verification before the loader boundary, so a reviewed dependency can drift after bootstrap validation.
Bootstrap, controller, and worker do not all require the same exact full receipt keyset and effect object; missing, extra, or wrong nonformal/formal/claim/security effects are not uniformly rejected.
The worker reports solver_calls as one plus hourly inventory length rather than deriving and cross-checking baseline, primary, and zero-DC confirmation calls from the validated canonical payload.
Production science and publication coverage relies on source-string assertions instead of an actual live dependency closure plus a registered zero-solver orchestration seam.
